description.value: A group-only campsite within Golden Ears Provincial Park — one of BC's largest and most visited parks about an hour east of Vancouver — with access to Alouette Lake swimming and coastal hemlock forest trails; the 15-adult minimum fee floor makes it impractical for solo riders or small touring groups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Woodlands Groupsite is a group-only campsite (OSM tag group_only=yes, capacity 50 persons) within Golden Ears Park, operated by BC Parks. The website confirms group camping requires a minimum of 15 adults for regular bookings or 12 people for youth groups, making it unsuitable for individual touring cyclists. OSM tags confirm drinking_water=yes and toilets=yes; the website confirms reservations are made via camping.bcparks.ca. No evidence of hiker/biker sites, showers, or power supply was found on the website.
concerns: Group-only site (group_only=yes) with minimum 15-adult booking requirement — not usable by individual touring cyclists
No cell phone service available at campgrounds per the website
Day-use pass required for Golden Ears Park during summer season
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a group-only campsite requiring a minimum of 15 adults (or 12 for youth groups). Individual touring cyclists or small cycling parties cannot book this site, making it a poor fit for a typical WWC directory listing unless the directory explicitly serves organized cycling clubs or large group tours.
enrichment_extras.notes: Golden Ears Park has three large campgrounds; individual frontcountry campsites within the park may be more appropriate for a cycling tourism directory than this group-only site.

wow_evidence: group-only campsite requiring a minimum of 15 adults... impractical for solo riders
